description: A step with no `workspaceRoot` is REFUSED rather than defaulted. The daemon serves every component on the machine, so defaulting to its own working directory would read the DAEMON's files, produce a plausible answer, and look like it worked — which is the worst of the three outcomes.

error.message: the step needs a workspace root

data.what: no workspaceRoot was given, and there is deliberately no default
data.means: the daemon serves every component on the machine, so its own working directory is not yours. A step that defaulted to it would read the daemon's files and the answer would look right
data.todo: send `workspaceRoot`; `aeon step` sends your working directory, and `--workspace` overrides it
